  [12] File: workflow-templates/validation-harness/_shared/tests/00_canary.sh.j2
      Problem: Shell injection vulnerability — tool names are embedded into a shell script without escaping. If a tool name contains double quotes, `$()`, backticks, or other metacharacters, the generated script executes arbitrary commands. Example: tool `$(rm -rf /)` results in `CANARY_TOOLS="$(rm -rf /)"` executing at assignment time. Additionally, the subsequent loop uses unquoted `${CANARY_TOOLS}`, risking word splitting/globbing with spaces or `*` in names.; Malformed or malicious tool names lead to command execution on the validation runner, compromising security and stability.
